117	// runTrailShow shows one trail, defaulting to the current branch's trail.
118	func runTrailShow(ctx context.Context, w, errW io.Writer, insecureHTTP bool, selector string) error {
119		return runAuthenticatedTrailAPI(ctx, errW, insecureHTTP, func(ctx context.Context, client *api.Client) error {
120			forge, owner, repo, err := resolveTrailRemote(ctx)
121			if err != nil {
122				return err
123			}
124	
125			found, err := resolveTrailBySelector(ctx, client, forge, owner, repo, selector)
126			if err != nil {
127				return err
128			}
129	
130			// Enrich the list result with the detail endpoint, which carries the
131			// rendered description (trail.body_document.text_snapshot) the list
132			// omits, and surface a browser URL. The detail fetch is best-effort:
133			// the core metadata already came from the list, so a detail failure
134			// falls back to the list body with a warning rather than failing.
135			m := found.ToMetadata()
136			webURL := trailDisplayURL(*found, forge, owner, repo)
137			// Seed the description from the list body so a failed (or skipped)
138			// detail fetch still shows something; a successful detail fetch
139			// supersedes it with the richer body_document text below.
140			bodyText := found.Body
141			descriptionLoaded := strings.TrimSpace(found.Body) != ""
142			if found.Number > 0 {
143				if bt, derr := fetchTrailDescription(ctx, client, forge, owner, repo, found.Number); derr == nil {
144					// A successful fetch means we authoritatively consulted the
145					// description, but it only supersedes the seeded list body when
146					// it actually carries text: an older/partial server that omits
147					// body_document returns "" here and must not blank out a list
148					// body that is present.
149					descriptionLoaded = true
150					if strings.TrimSpace(bt) != "" {
151						bodyText = bt
152					}
153				} else {
154					// Best-effort: warn but still render metadata + URL (and the
155					// list body) rather than failing the whole command.
156					fmt.Fprintf(errW, "Warning: could not load trail description: %v\n", derr)
157				}
158			}
159			printTrailDetails(w, m, webURL, trailDescriptionForDisplay(bodyText, descriptionLoaded))
160			return nil
161		})
162	}

166	// trail. It returns an actionable error (never a nil trail with a nil error)
167	// when nothing matches, so callers can rely on a non-nil result.
168	func resolveTrailBySelector(ctx context.Context, client *api.Client, forge, owner, repo, selector string) (*api.TrailResource, error) {
169		selector = strings.TrimSpace(selector)
170		if selector == "" {
171			branch, err := GetCurrentBranch(ctx)
172			if err != nil {

174			}
175			found, err := findTrailByBranch(ctx, client, forge, owner, repo, branch)

177				return nil, err
178			}
179			if found == nil {

183		}
184		found, err := findTrailBySelector(ctx, client, forge, owner, repo, selector)

189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no trail %q found in %s/%s/%s (run 'entire trail list --status any')", selector, forge, owner, repo)

191		return found, nil
192	}

259	// older servers that omit the field.
260	func trailDisplayURL(t api.TrailResource, forge, owner, repo string) string {

272	// <web-origin>/<forge>/<owner>/<repo>/trails/<number>. In production the web app
273	// is served from the same origin as the data API, so the API base URL doubles
274	// as the web origin. A split local-dev setup (API and frontend on different
275	// ports) would point this at the API port rather than the dev frontend.
276	func trailWebURL(base, forge, owner, repo string, number int) string {
277		return strings.TrimRight(base, "/") + "/" + forge + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + "/trails/" + strconv.Itoa(number)

284	// unaffected by the shape of sibling fields like `checkpoints`/`thread`.
285	func fetchTrailDescription(ctx context.Context, client *api.Client, forge, owner, repo string, number int) (string, error) {

432	// endpoint. Empty statusFilters (--status any) omits the status param so the

438	func trailListQueryWithOffset(statusFilters []trail.Status, author string, limit, offset int) string {
439		q := url.Values{}
440		if len(statusFilters) > 0 {
441			parts := make([]string, len(statusFilters))
442			for i, status := range statusFilters {
443				parts[i] = string(status)
444			}
445			q.Set("status", strings.Join(parts, ","))
446		}
447		if author != "" {
448			q.Set("author", author)
449		}
450		if limit > trailListServerMaxLimit {
451			limit = trailListServerMaxLimit
452		}
453		q.Set("limit", strconv.Itoa(limit))
454		if offset > 0 {
455			q.Set("offset", strconv.Itoa(offset))
456		}
457		return "?" + q.Encode()

486	func parseTrailStatusFilter(filter string) ([]trail.Status, error) {
487		if filter == "" || filter == trailListStatusAny {
488			return nil, nil
489		}
490	
491		parts := strings.Split(filter, ",")
492		statuses := make([]trail.Status, 0, len(parts))
493		seen := make(map[trail.Status]bool, len(parts))
494		for _, part := range parts {
495			name := strings.TrimSpace(part)
496			if name == "" {
497				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid status filter %q: empty status", filter)
498			}
499			status := trail.Status(name)
500			if !status.IsValid() {
501				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid status %q: valid values are %s", name, formatValidStatuses())
502			}
503			if seen[status] {
504				continue
505			}
506			seen[status] = true
507			statuses = append(statuses, status)
508		}
509		return statuses, nil
510	}

832	func prepareTrailCreateBranch(w, errW io.Writer, repo *git.Repository, branch, currentBranch string, noBranch bool) (trailCreateBranchState, error) {
833		var state trailCreateBranchState
834		if noBranch || branch == "" {
835			// Branchless trails have no remote branch to create, fetch, or push.
836			return state, nil
837		}
838	
839		state.NeedsCreation = branchNeedsCreation(repo, branch)
840		existedOnOrigin, existErr := branchExistsOnOrigin(branch)
841		if existErr != nil {
842			fmt.Fprintf(errW, "Warning: could not check whether branch %s already exists on origin: %v\n", branch, existErr)
843			existedOnOrigin = true
844		}
845	
846		if err := ensureTrailCreateBranchExists(w, repo, branch, currentBranch, existedOnOrigin, &state); err != nil {
847			return state, err
848		}
849	
850		// For branch-backed trails, always push the branch first: the trail binds to a
851		// remote branch, so deliver it before creating the trail rather than letting
852		// the server backfill it at the base tip. Branchless trails skip this entirely.
853		if err := pushBranchToOrigin(branch); err != nil {
854			cleanupCreatedTrailBranch(repo, branch, state.LocalCreated, false, errW)
855			return state, fmt.Errorf("failed to push branch %q to origin: %w\nhint: the trail was not created because its branch could not be delivered to the remote.\n  - if this is an auth error, link your GitHub account and retry\n  - if this is a non-fast-forward, update branch %q from origin and retry", branch, err, branch)
856		}
857		state.RemotePushed = !existedOnOrigin
858		fmt.Fprintf(w, "Pushed branch %s to origin\n", branch)
859		return state, nil
860	}

1012				return err
1013			}

1020			title := inputs.Title
1021			body := inputs.Body
1022			noFlags := !inputs.StatusChanged && !inputs.TitleChanged && !inputs.BodyChanged && inputs.LabelAdd == nil && inputs.LabelRemove == nil
1023			if noFlags {

1026				var statusOptions []huh.Option[string]
1027				for _, s := range trail.ValidStatuses() {
1028					if (s == trail.StatusMerged || s == trail.StatusClosed) && s != metadata.Status {
1029						continue
1030					}
1031					label := string(s)
1032					if s == metadata.Status {
1033						label += " (current)"

1059				inputs.TitleChanged = true
1060				inputs.BodyChanged = true

## What shipped

**`--repo` (persistent on `trail` root)** — accepts `gh/entireio/cli` or a clone URL; defaults to origin. Honored by `show`, `list`, `update`, `delete`, `watch`, `finding` (+ subcommands). **Rejected** on the local-clone commands (`create`, `checkout`, `finding apply`) with a clear error.
